Fictional case: Zentaril and acute liver injury
Fictional journal — synthetic case for software testing. DOI: 10.0000/fake.case
Abstract
A 58-year-old fictional woman developed jaundice six weeks after Zentaril 20 mg daily.
Bilirubin peaked at 4.1 mg/dL. The drug was stopped and enzymes improved. Identifiable as a
single patient case.
Case report

six weeks after Zentaril 20 mg daily. Bilirubin

enzymes improved. Identifiable as a single
patient case. Discussion of DILI mechanisms in
general should be ignored. This paragraph is
